message:
The storms are rolling in, and while they can stir up a bit of excitement, I always like to turn these moments into cozy family events. It’s a great time to gather supplies, perhaps make some hot cocoa, and reminisce about our favorite stormy day memories. I find that having a plan in place makes everything feel a little less daunting and a lot more manageable. 

So, if you’re looking for a helpful resource on how to prepare, I recommend checking out what the Red Cross suggests. It’s like pulling out a favorite board game before the rain starts—it just makes everything feel a bit more comfortable. 

What’s your favorite way to make a stormy day feel warm and inviting? ☕
